quest_pool.title: Post These Wanted Posters
quest_pool.objective: Post 5 wanted posters around the campfire
quest_pool.description: We got some outlaws causin' trouble. Post these wanted posters around the campfire.

quest_pool.title: Coyote Problem
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 3 coyotes in the abandoned mine
quest_pool.description: Coyotes been hiding in that old mine. Deal with 'em.

quest_pool.title: Gold Rush
quest_pool.objective: Collect 8 gold nuggets from the abandoned mine
quest_pool.description: There's still gold in that old mine, sugar! Bring me some nuggets and I'll pay fair.

quest_pool.title: Bandit Trouble
quest_pool.objective: Hunt down 2 bandits hiding near the campfire
quest_pool.description: Got reports of bandits lurking around. Bring 'em to justice!

quest_pool.title: Fresh Meat
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 5 rabbits on the open plains
quest_pool.description: Darlin', I need fresh meat for the kitchen. Could you hunt me some rabbits out on the plains?

quest_pool.title: Big Game
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 2 pronghorn on the open plains
quest_pool.description: I got a special order, sugar. Need some pronghorn for a fancy dinner. Think you can handle it?

quest_pool.title: Herbal Remedies
quest_pool.objective: Gather 6 sage from the open plains
quest_pool.description: Doc needs some sage for medicine, darlin'. Folks been gettin' sick and we're runnin' low.

quest_pool.title: Silver Strike
quest_pool.objective: Mine 5 silver ore from the abandoned mine
quest_pool.description: A jeweler's comin' through town next week. Get me some silver ore and I'll make it worth your while.

quest_pool.title: Wolf Pack
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 2 wolves on the open plains
quest_pool.description: Wolves been spookin' the cattle. Ranchers are complainin'. Handle it.

quest_pool.title: Snake Pit
quest_pool.objective: Clear 4 rattlesnakes from the abandoned mine
quest_pool.description: Miners found a nest of rattlers down in the old shaft. Make it safe for 'em.

quest_pool.title: Fuel for the Forge
quest_pool.objective: Gather 10 coal from the abandoned mine
quest_pool.description: Blacksmith needs coal. Town's runnin' low and winter's comin'.

quest_pool.title: Wild Mustang
quest_pool.objective: Tame a wild horse on the open plains
quest_pool.description: Town could use more horses. There's wild mustangs out on the plains. Bring one back.

quest_pool.title: The Great Hunt
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 1 bison on the open plains
quest_pool.description: Sugar, I need bison meat for the biggest feast this town's ever seen. Think you're up for it?

quest_pool.title: Trail Medicine
quest_pool.objective: Gather 4 wild herbs from the open plains
quest_pool.description: Travelers comin' through need medicine for the road. Get me some wild herbs, would ya?

quest_pool.title: Eyes in the Sky
quest_pool.objective: Tame a hawk on the open plains
quest_pool.description: A trained hawk would help us spot trouble comin'. There's hawks out on the plains.

quest_pool.title: Chicken Thieves
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 3 hawks on the open plains
quest_pool.description: Hawks been stealin' chickens from the farms, darlin'. Farmers are mighty upset.

quest_pool.title: Explosive Situation
quest_pool.objective: Carefully recover 2 dynamite from the abandoned mine
quest_pool.description: Old dynamite in that mine is dangerous. Retrieve it careful-like before someone gets hurt.
